basis.quote: I fell in the kitchen this morning and my right hip hurts badly. I can't put any weight on that leg.
basis.interpretation: 71-year-old female reports acute right hip pain after a fall with inability to bear weight on the affected leg, concerning for hip fracture or other serious lower-limb injury requiring immediate emergency-department assessment and appropriate transport.

output.reason: Acute hip pain with weight-bearing inability after fall indicates possible hip fracture; immediate emergency assessment and safe transport required.

notice.directive: Call 911 now. Do not drive yourself or wait for a message reply.

output.reason: 71-year-old with fall this morning, severe right hip pain and complete inability to bear weight — presentation consistent with proximal femur fracture requiring immediate imaging and orthopedic assessment; safe transfer of a non-weight-bearing patient needs ambulance.
output.patientMessage: Please call 911 now for an ambulance and do not try to stand or walk on that leg. A fall with severe hip pain and inability to put weight on the leg in someone your age can mean a broken hip, which needs emergency imaging and orthopedic care today; X-rays can look normal, so hands-on assessment is essential. If you develop faintness, confusion or worsening pain while waiting, tell the 911 dispatcher.
differential: Proximal femoral (hip) fracture, including occult fracture with normal X-ray
Severe soft-tissue/contusion injury or hip dislocation
